Incredible service in every department. The friendly and welcoming atmosphere makes it a pleasant place to fill up, enjoy a delicious coffee, get mechanical service, request roadside assistance, visit the administration office, and feel the warmth of everyone there.

They do their job with so much passion, respect, dedication, willingness, and humility. Congratulations! You couldn't ask for more!

Many thanks to everyone who works at ACA in Mar del Plata.

reviews.comment:
Una de mis estaciones de servicio favoritas. La atención siempre es muy buena, está bien ubicada y tiene muchos surtidores, por lo que no tenes que esperar tanto tiempo. Lo único malo es que ahora te cobran el aire para inflar, pero bueno, tampoco es mucho. Además para socios ACA te hacen un 5% de descuento, no es mucho pero suma. Siempre que puedo voy (hoy justo fui). Recomiendo.

(Translated by Google)
One of my favorite gas stations. The service is always great, it's well-located, and it has plenty of pumps, so you don't have to wait long. The only downside is that they now charge extra for air, but it's not much. Plus, ACA members get a 5% discount, which isn't much, but it helps. I go whenever I can (I went today, actually). I recommend it.
